# SmoothFaceTracking
![Release version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Purpzie/ResoSmoothFT)
[![Available on Thunderstore](https://img.shields.io/badge/Available_on-Thunderstore-blue)](https://thunderstore.io/c/resonite/)
![No AI](https://img.shields.io/badge/No_AI-green.svg?logo=data:image/svg%2bxml;base64,)

A [Resonite](https://resonite.com/) mod that smooths your face tracking locally before it gets synced with other players.

## Manual Installation
1. Install [BepisLoader](https://github.com/ResoniteModding/BepisLoader) for Resonite.
2. Download the latest release ZIP file (e.g., `Purpzie-SmoothFaceTracking-1.0.0.zip`) from the [Releases](https://github.com/Purpzie/SmoothFaceTracking/releases) page.
3. Extract the ZIP and copy the `plugins` folder to your BepInEx folder in your Resonite installation directory:
   - **Default location:** `C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Resonite\BepInEx\`
4. Start the game. If you want to verify that the mod is working you can check your BepInEx logs.

## Usage
Once installed, your face tracking will be smoothed by default.
Smoothing speed and toggles can be found in your settings under `BepInEx > SmoothFaceTracking`.
